## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] The tool works today and has real users.
- [ ] The link is the plain home page or feature page, with no affiliate or referral code.
- [ ] The description comes from the tool's own site, not its marketing slogans.
- [ ] Pricing is marked Free, Freemium or Paid, with a starting price if the site shows one.
- [ ] A well-known downside is mentioned, if there is one.
- [ ] Repos include license and approximate stars.
- [ ] The entry follows `- [Name](link) - Description.` and sits in the right section.
